messages:
leila: FYI canary just hit ~10% failure on auth-exchange rollback path — saw spike in 401s. rolling back canary now. /cc @sam @ryan
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollback started for release auth-exchange v2 -> v1
sam: what telemetry do we have? need which keys failed, tenant buckets, and quota hits
leila: stack traces show auth proxy returning 401 when project header missing during exchange; hits concentrated in org-42. telemetry: trace id abc123, sampling was low so counts might be underreported
ryan: is this the origin-binding change? we changed fallback to try projectless-exchange. maybe a regression in header parsing
leila: yep. new logic assumed header `x-origin-project` always present. console requests from our CI pipeline don't include it. we should fall back to original token-affinity routing instead of hard-failing
sam: agree. temp fix: set flag `auth.exchange.strict_origin=false` in canary hosts and re-deploy? also flush quota caches to avoid stale mapping hits
leila: I pushed that flag to canary via console feature flag: `auth.exchange.strict_origin=false` — infra shows immediate drop in 401s on canary :relieved:
ops: confirming. But quick ask: telemetry events were sparse; we need better rollout observability. request: add `exchange.path` tag and emit a hashed token id + tenant_id hash on failure samples
ryan: +1. we should avoid logging raw token. hashed digest is fine. I'll also add a meter `auth.exchange.failures` with labels {env, org, route, flag_state} so we can slice by flag
maya: can we add a quick dashboard tile in Console under "Auth rollout" showing failure rate by `flag_state`? would help future rollouts and standups
leila: :thumbsup: I'll open a PR for dashboard config. also propose automated rollback rule: if failure rate >2% for 5m in canary, rollback and set flag to previous value
sam: can we make it 1%? for auth flows 1% sustained is risky. but also want to avoid noisy flaps
ryan: suggestion: two-stage policy. 1% sustained for 5m -> alert + pause (no further ramp). 2% sustained for 3m -> auto-rollback. adds hysteresis and avoids thundering rollbacks
leila: sounds good. I'll add suggestion to rollout policy doc and the PR. also let's capture failed request samples up to 50/hr for postmortem analysis (hashed fields only)
maya: also request telemetry backfill for last 24h; want to check if low-signal was due to sampling rules. @sam can you bump sampling for `auth.exchange` events to 100% for the canary group for the next hour?
sam: on it. toggled sampling to 100% for canary via pipeline. will revert after 1h and note in the incident log
infra-bot: sampling toggle applied to service auth-proxy(canary), id=xyz
ryan: quick checklist for follow-up: PR for fallback flag + tests, dashboard tile, rollout rule change, metric labels + meter, sampling change. I'll own metric labels + meter
leila: I'll own dashboard + PR. @maya please own postmortem doc and link telemetry traces. @sam to own sampling and rollout automation
maya: will do. filing a short incident note in incidents channel and adding links to traces/abc123
leila: thanks team. we'll keep this thread for updates. once canary stable we'll re-run canary with hardened tests for projectless request paths and add a unit test for header-absent cases
